title: Har gali abbas ki
body:
har gali abbas ki hai har nagar abbas ka
dushman e deen ko laga rehta hai darr abbas ka
hazarte abbas maula hazarte abbas
<<DIVIDER>>
jab imam e waqt layenge alam abbas ka
aqs aayega zamane ko nazar abbas ka
hazarte abbas maula hazarte abbas
har gali abbas ki hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
rakh diya itni bulandi par wafa ke naam ko
bewafayi aaj bhi rakhti hai darr abbas ka
hazarte abbas maula hazarte abbas
har gali abbas ki hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
karbala ki jang ka naksha badal jaata zaroor
dekhti fauj e yazeedi ghaiz agar abbas ka
hazarte abbas maula hazarte abbas
har gali abbas ki hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek nazar pe ruk gaya nau laakh ka lashkar jahan
ashkiyan pe rob tha kuch is qadar abbas ka
hazarte abbas maula hazarte abbas
har gali abbas ki hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
na hui himmat kabhi dushman ki aaye karbala
hai khat e abbas mein ab bhi asar abbas ka
hazarte abbas maula hazarte abbas
har gali abbas ki hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
sindh ki dharti pe saaya kar raha hai aaj bhi
tumko aayega alam ghar ghar nazar abbas ka
hazarte abbas maula hazarte abbas
har gali abbas ki hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
gar karo waada kisi se usko poora bhi karo
chaahne waalon mein bhi to ho asar abbas ka
hazarte abbas maula hazarte abbas
har gali abbas ki hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
keh do mujhko bhai bas ek baar ay bhai mere
bole sarwar godh mein le kar ye sar abbas ka
hazarte abbas maula hazarte abbas
har gali abbas ki hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
hai amood o shadman ki ye dua abbas se
in pe ho nazr e karam shaam o sahar abbas ka
hazarte abbas maula hazarte abbas
har gali abbas ki hai...
author: Amood Peryanivi
